text:
zoe: quick flag from the quarterly KMS posture check: a handful of service accounts have key-admin on the prod keyring but no evidence of use in >120 days. starting a short triage thread so we have paper trail before any changes.

ops-oncall: can you paste the SAs and how you found them?

zoe: redacted list: 
- serviceAccount:ci-broker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- serviceAccount:old-etl@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- group:infra-deprecated-admins@redwood.com

zoe: query used:
```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.admin")'
```

marco: i can run last-use checks in logs and scheduler. prefer evidence-driven removals.

ops-oncall: runbook suggestion: 1) gather last_call from audit logs, 2) capture pre-snapshot to GCS, 3) run dry-run revoke, 4) canary revoke for 1 SA during MW, 5) 48h rollback watch.

sre-lead: for infra-deprecated-admins group, prefer to narrow to roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator and create direct bindings for current owners instead of removing group outright. less noisy.

zoe: agree. here's a BigQuery snippet to get last KMS activity by principal:
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
       MAX(timestamp) AS last_call
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE resource.type='cloud_kms_key'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY principal
ORDER BY last_call DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

ops-oncall: dry-run revoke example:
```bash
# preview removal
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:old-etl@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.admin' --format=json --dry-run
```

audit-bot: snapshot scheduled: gs://redwood-audit/iam-snapshots/3108600001-pre.json. log export job enqueued (audit-3108600001).

zoe: timeline: marco will attach BigQuery results by 15:00 PT, ops-oncall can run canary during MW 23:00-01:00 PT if owners/HR confirmations attached. i'll file SEC-6210 and attach snapshots + justification.

marco: attaching results now (redacted) to SEC-6210. ci-broker shows no KMS calls in 14 months. old-etl last_call = 2025-08-10. infra-deprecated-admins has 6 members, 4 active. recommend membership prune before any group-level change.

ops-oncall: thanks. i'll queue the canary for old-etl in mw if no objections. include exact revert commands in the ticket so rollback is fast.

zoe: will add revert snippet and link the snapshots. tagging this thread: mw-23-01 and kms-prune. :white_check_mark:
